allocation_rule: Divide each complete three-family constructor interval equally across the three families; included verification, integration and failed-attempt time is never charged twice. These are elapsed role intervals, not active human or billed inference time.
shared_construction_basis: Explicit scenario-resource proxy for unmetered root authoring: 300s forward, 600s inverse, and 300s original design. Add one third of the observed independent author's 225.038953s interval for the contributed design. These are assumptions, not measurements, lower bounds or favorable estimates.
shared_integration_basis: Separately declared 600-second scenario proxy; actual root reverse-acquisition/integration duration was not isolated. Do not substitute the opposite recipient's 175.825650-second interval.
failed_candidates: Allocate actual preserved failed development invocation elapsed across three families; blocked, never-executed stages have no execution charge but retain upstream construction/attempt costs.
validation: Allocate actual source-bound admission/revalidation elapsed once across three generations; later upkeep/revalidation follows explicit schedule assumptions.
index_construction: Measured original catalogue/receipt construction once per simulated enterprise; B/C share the same actual validation evidence. No per-job retrieval added when complete-stage CPU already includes it.
complete_cost_schedules: Use the preregistered low/reference/high schedules for model/tool, residual attention, search, maintenance and revalidation categories; all are scenario assumptions. Actual UNKNOWN account cannot pass full-cost or financing gates.
currency: USD scenarios only; no expenditure or transaction
